items.title: No baseline of recall intervals by recorded risk in the network
items.whyItMatters: Commissioners plan contract changes without knowing current practice.
items.opportunity: Sample records from all 14 practices in one month.

items.title: The risk field is an unreliable reference
items.whyItMatters: Blank or copied-forward fields (claim c2) make concordance hard to judge.
items.opportunity: Add independent markers and report copy-forward rates.

items.title: Missing intervals in deprived areas
items.whyItMatters: Excluding blanks would hide the group least served (claim c4).
items.opportunity: Report missing intervals as an outcome by deprivation quintile.

items.title: Three practices without signed agreements
items.whyItMatters: A partial sample could bias the network estimate.
items.opportunity: Delay extraction until all 14 sign, or report which practices are missing.

reevaluation: The investigator's cross-sectional choice fits the gaps: the missing piece is a current measure, not safety.
summary: Four gaps; the missing baseline and the unreliable risk field are high severity.
